# Runtime.MiRust.com Retired Agent Bundle

Runtime.MiRust.com is no longer a standalone documentation authority. The Runtime documentation corpus was consolidated into TinyRustLM.MiRust.com, where it is preserved under a checksum-bearing archive and updated as part of the TinyRustLM developer portal.

## Canonical Routes

- Developer portal: https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/developer-portal/
- Current app: https://tinyrustlm.com/
- Legacy archive index: https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/docs/runtime-portal/index.md
- Legacy archive manifest: https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/docs/runtime-portal/MANIFEST.md
- Current llms.txt: https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/llms.txt
- Current llms-full.txt: https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/llms-full.txt

## Redirect Policy

Runtime.MiRust.com should serve redirects only:

- `/docs/*` redirects into `https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/docs/runtime-portal/runtime-docs/*`
- `/llms.txt` redirects to `https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/llms.txt`
- `/llms-full.txt` redirects to `https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/llms-full.txt`
- ordinary project routes redirect to `https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/developer-portal/`

## Agent Boundary

Agents should not treat Runtime.MiRust.com as current authority. Read TinyRustLM.MiRust.com for current developer evidence, then use the legacy archive only for historical implementation memory.

Project servers do not run user model bytes. Project servers do not serve runnable user model bytes. TinyRustLM.com remains browser-local and accepts local `.slm` imports through the browser file picker.
